BETWEEN:-
 KAMLESH GADEWAL S/O LATE AMARLAL GADEWAL,
 AGED ABOUT 50 YEARS, OCCUPATION: PEON IN  GOVERNMENT SCHOOL R/O BHAYDE COLONY WARD

NO 45 LONIYA KARBAL P.S. DEHAT CHHINDWARA  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI MUKESH KUMAR PANDEY - ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION CITY KOTWALI DISTRICT CHHINDWARA  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI G.S. THAKUR - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the  following:
 ORDER
This is second application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of anticipatory bail.

2. Applicant is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.138/2022 registered at Police Station City Kotwali District Chhindwara M.P.) for offences punishable under Sections 420, 406,
409, 34, 120-B of the IPC.

Applicant wants to deposit the said amount before the trial Court.

sentences.text: 1 granted anticipatory bail.
4. Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of anticipatory bail.

5. Heard counsel for the parties.
6.
Most of the evidence available in the case diary is documentary in nature.
Applicant is ready to deposit the defalcated amount.
He is a government servant and there is no chance of his absconding from law.
7. Applicant is ready to deposit Rs.2,60,845/- before the C.J.M. and further applicant has also undertaken to cooperate in investigation of the case and will attend the trial regularly.

8. Considering aforesaid circumstances, anticipatory bail application filed by the applicant is allowed on following conditions:-
(i) Applicant shall deposit an amount of Rs.2,60,845/- before Court of C.J.M.
Amount deposited will be kept in form of FDR and will be subject to final judgment which will be passed by the trial court.
(ii) Applicant will produce receipt of the same before the Investigating Officer.
(iii) If said amount is not deposited then no application will be entertained for modification of conditions of bail order.

9 . It is also directed that in the event of arrest of applicant and on producing receipt of the amount deposited in connection with the aforesaid crime number and the offences, he be released on anticipatory bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum o f Rs.50,000/- (Rs. fifty thousand only)
with a solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/Arresting Authority.
10.
The applicant is directed to join the investigation immediately and to co-operate with the investigating agency.

He will further abide by the conditions enumerated in sub-section (2) of Section 438 of the Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.
